messages.TMA_JSON_INVALID: {where}: the file is not a JSON object.
messages.TMA_SCHEMA_NEWER: {where}: schema {value} needs a newer game build (this one reads schema {schema}).
messages.TMA_CENTER_IN_TMA: {where}: center unit "{value}" must live in acc_definitions.json.
messages.TMA_ID_MISMATCH: {where}: id "{value}" must equal the bundle folder name "{expected}".
messages.TMA_AIRPORT_INVALID: {where}: "{value}" is not a four-character ICAO code.
messages.TMA_AIRPORT_NOT_IN_TMA: {where}: airport "{value}" is not in the TMA's airports.
messages.TMA_UNIT_NO_SERVICES: {where}: has no services. Use one or more of: {allowed}.
messages.TMA_UNIT_SERVICE_UNKNOWN: {where}: service "{value}" is not in the list. Use one or more of: {allowed}.
messages.TMA_UNIT_AIRPORT_MISSING: {where}: a {value} unit must name its airport.
messages.TMA_UNIT_PART_OF_CALLSIGN: {where}: sub-centre unit "{value}" with part_of must not set call_sign.
messages.TMA_UNIT_PART_OF_UNKNOWN: {where}: part_of "{value}" is not a parent unit in units.
messages.TMA_UNASSIGNED_FREQ_USED: {where}: unassigned_frequencies repeats frequency "{value}" already assigned to a position.
messages.TMA_FREQUENCY_INVALID: {where}: frequency "{value}" must look like 131.125 and lie between 118.000 and 136.990 MHz.
messages.TMA_SECTOR_MADE_OF_AND_VOLUMES: {where}: sector "{value}" cannot both appear in volumes and set made_of.
messages.TMA_SECTOR_TWICE: {where}: sector "{value}" has two workers in this configuration.
messages.TMA_SECTOR_UNBOUND: {where}: {value} has no unit. The center works it.
messages.TMA_CONFIG_DIGIT_MISMATCH: {where}: configuration "{value}" leading digit does not match its {expected} open positions.
messages.TMA_POSITION_NOT_PLAYABLE: {where}: unit "{value}" cannot be played. Only sectors you can play are listed; a position's unit needs one of: {allowed}.
messages.TMA_LEVEL_INVALID: {where}: level "{value}" must be F and three digits (F130), A and three digits (A060), EVEN, or ODD.
messages.TMA_AGREEMENT_SAME_UNIT: {where}: agreement "{value}" goes from a unit to itself.
messages.TMA_AGREEMENT_TIE: {where}: agreements "{value}" and "{expected}" cover the same flow with equal specificity.
messages.TMA_AGREEMENT_LEVEL_SHARED: {where}: agreements "{value}" and "{expected}" meet at {fix} at the same level; give each flow its own level.
messages.TMA_ZONE_UNKNOWN: {where}: "{value}" is not a sector in zones.
messages.TMA_UNIT_CODE: {where}: code "{value}" must be ICAO_part_TYPE (an ICAO code, at most one part -- capital letters or numbers, never ALL, none for a unit that works the whole airport -- then _TWR, _APP, _CTR or _AFIS, such as LEMD_ALN_APP or LEMD_TWR) or the typed form: an ICAO or FIR code, then two to six capitals or digits and no underscore, such as LECPIXX or LECBBKW.
